text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since joining Tracen Academy as a<n>trainer, the days have been
flying by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While out on a stroll, I find myself walking<n>around the nearby
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm done moving the last box, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Done already? I'm sorry, dear.<n>They were heavy, weren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm used to doing all sorts of<n>heavy lifting back in
Hokkaido with my<n>mom! I had to help around the family farm!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Carrying a few boxes of veggies is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But enough about that! How's your hip,<n>ma'am?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text: Oh, I feel much better thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
You're a student at Tracen Academy,<n>right? I'm so sorry to bother you
in the<n>middle of training. Thank you so much for<n>your help.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No problem! Anyway, I gotta head back<n>now! Take care!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hm? She ran off in the complete opposite<n>direction of the academy...
Will she be all<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried that Special Week might be lost, I<n>decide to follow her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew! It's the first time I've ran this far out. This really was 
a nice outing for a change~…Wait!!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Where even am I?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-w-w-w-what do I do?! I'm gonna miss<n>the dorm curfew!
choice_data_list: Would you like to get back to TracenAcademy?
Would you like to get back to TracenAcademy?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Um, you are...?
choice_data_list: I'm a trainer. I'll show you the way back.
I'm a trainer. I'll show you the way back.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! We made it back just in<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I have a big race tomorrow, so I<n>thought I'd spend some of my
time off<n>training. I might've gone a bit too far,<n>though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I just moved here from the countryside, so<n>I'm still not used to finding
my way around<n>the city... You really did come at the<n>perfect time!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe! You're back! The school gates<n>were about to close for the
day, and you<n>still weren't here, so I got a bit worried...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka! I'm sorry for making you<n>worry!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... all righty then. Trainer, thanks again<n>for bringing me back in one
piece! I gotta<n>go now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: See ya!

With a smile on her face, Special Week<n>heads back to the Ritto
dormitory. Silence<n>Suzuka bows lightly towards me before<n>following
behind her.
The next morning...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! It's finally time for<n>the tryout races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These races happen every two months<n>starting from June for a grand
total of four<n>times per year. All the up-and-coming<n>students gather to
show off their abilities,<n>and prove to the world that they're<n>race-ready.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Every student here will be gunning to<n>prove their skills to the best
trainers in<n>hopes of getting scouted!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure today's races will be just as<n>exciting as ever.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please do!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A trainer is meant to serve as a racer's<n>guide—to support them when
times are<n>tough, to lead them down the right path,<n>and to seek glory
together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I hope you meet someone whom you can<n>share a mutual bond of trust.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But in any case, good luck!

The tryouts begin shortly after, and the<n>many trainers in attendance
gaze upon the<n>rows of students in search of a runner with<n>potential.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yo soy el número uno! This condor is<n>gonna soar to the edge of the
sky!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Which lucky trainer is willing to<n>stand by my side? Any
takers?

Although every student running today is<n>exceptionally skilled, one in
particular<n>stands out—her running is immaculate!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're at the race's last stretch! One final<n>corner! At the center of
everybody's<n>attention is Special Week! She's in third<n>place, but it'll
be a close one!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Now!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Special Week suddenly pulls ahead! She's<n>weaving her way to the
very front! She<n>takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet! Hraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Special Week widens her lead! She's<n>ensuring the win! She takes first
place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I did it! I won! Now I—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're the person from yesterday! You<n>came to watch the race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thanks! I hope I managed to show<n>you what I'm capable of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I came to Tracen Academy to achieve my<n>dream, and it all starts with
my debut... I'll<n>make sure it happens, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in the most prestigious races,<n>where only the best of the
best racers are<n>allowed—the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I have to run! I have to win! I have to<n>become strong enough that I
don't ever<n>lose! If I do that, then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the best racer in all of<n>Japan—for me, for Mom and Mama,
and<n>for everybody else back home!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's my dream!

Special Week gazes straight at me with an<n>intense look of
determination.

It's as if just beyond those glimmering<n>eyes, she can see the shining
future she<n>dreams of gazing back at her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh... U-um... Are you still with me? Did I<n>say something weird? Sorry
about that...
choice_data_list: I want to help you with your dream!
I want to help you with your dream!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Please, let me be your trainer!
Please, let me be your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait... Are you scouting me?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I'd love for you to be my<n>Trainer!
And with that, I become Special Week's<n>trainer.
